beats.text: Household goods cost 100 in USA, but in India they cost just 23.
Egypt is the world's lowest at 16, where US dollars buy the most.
Near the top, Denmark sits at 105, Switzerland at 128, and Iceland at 130.
China sits near the global median at 48, with prices well below America.
Between the extremes, Iceland has 130 while Egypt has just 16.
